milestones.title: M0 Foundation
milestones.description: Build the repository, toolchains, evidence pipeline and shared contracts. No product code merges until M0 closes.

milestones.title: M1 Core services
milestones.description: Build the C++ foundation, the SITL rig and every data-ingest path: timing, PLI and camera I/O.

milestones.title: M2 Station control
milestones.description: Build the encoder time-tagger, mount control, tracking and triggering. Critical path: staff ICS-032 and ICS-035 in month 1.

milestones.title: M3 Python models
milestones.description: Write every algorithm first as a reviewed Python reference with golden outputs; the C++ ports in M4 must match them.

milestones.title: M4 Algorithms
milestones.description: Port each Python reference to C++ and gate every port on parity with its golden files.

milestones.title: M5 Front end
milestones.description: Build the read-only operator and evaluator interface on ics-api.

milestones.title: M6 Integration and release
milestones.description: Prove the system on the bench, then in the field in validation-event order, then release with the full evidence package.

tasks.title: Create the monorepo and protections
steps: Create ics on the CUI-authorized host with the Build plan layout.
Protect main: two approvals, signed commits, linear history.
Add the CTI banner and SECURITY.md.
tasks.done_when: Unsigned or unreviewed pushes to main fail

tasks.title: Add CONTRIBUTING, task card and Definition of Done
steps: Write CONTRIBUTING with the task card and Definition of Done.
tasks.done_when: Templates render on new issues and pull requests

tasks.title: Add AI-assist controls per DoWI 8430.01 §3.6
steps: Add an ai-assisted checkbox to the pull-request template.
Require a second human approver when checked.
Log model, version and scope in docs/ai-usage.md.
tasks.done_when: CI blocks merge until the checkbox is answered

tasks.title: Build C++ toolchain containers
steps: Build images with GCC 13, Clang 17 and CUDA 12.
Add CMake presets for debug, release, asan and tsan.
Pin dependencies with a Conan 2 lockfile.
tasks.done_when: A sample target builds bit-identically twice on both compilers

tasks.title: Encode the C++ Power-of-Ten profile
steps: Add a malloc hook that fails tests on post-init allocation.
tasks.done_when: CI fails on one seeded violation of each rule

tasks.title: Build the Python toolchain
steps: Pin Python 3.12 and dependencies with uv.
Configure ruff, mypy --strict, pytest and hypothesis.
Add AST checks for recursion and function length.
tasks.done_when: CI fails on an untyped or recursive function

tasks.title: Build the TypeScript toolchain
steps: Create a pnpm workspace with Vite and React 18.
Configure ESLint: no any, no non-null assertion, no floating promises, 50-line functions.
tasks.done_when: CI fails on any, !, var or a floating promise

tasks.title: Build CI test stages
steps: Add build and unit stages for all languages.
Add ASan, UBSan and TSan builds.
Add libFuzzer runs per merge and nightly.
Add clang-tidy, cppcheck, CodeQL, ruff, mypy and ESLint.
tasks.done_when: Seeded defects fail each stage; clean code passes

tasks.title: Build CI evidence stages
steps: Generate CycloneDX SBOMs with Syft for Conan, uv and pnpm.
tasks.done_when: Every merge publishes a signed SBOM and attestation

tasks.title: Open the dependency register per DoWI 8430.01 §3.5.i
steps: Record governance, sustainment, license and foreign-influence review.
tasks.done_when: CI rejects a new unregistered dependency

tasks.title: Set up protobuf tooling
steps: Add buf with lint and breaking-change checks.
Generate C++, Python and TypeScript code.
Publish generated packages in the monorepo.
tasks.done_when: buf generate runs in CI for all three languages

tasks.title: Define ICS protobuf messages
steps: Define Track, Fragment, KillAssessment, Footprint and RunRecord.
tasks.done_when: buf lint passes; all three language leads approve

tasks.title: Publish the run-record JSON Schema
steps: Write the JSON Schema keyed to C4 MOP and KPP IDs.
tasks.done_when: All 20 samples validate

tasks.title: Fix frame and time conventions
steps: Document WGS84, range ENU origin, UTC as int64 ns and ellipsoid heights.
Generate golden conversion vectors with GeographicLib.
tasks.done_when: Golden vectors merged into golden/

tasks.title: Build common error and container types
steps: Wrap tl::expected with an ICS error enum.
Build StaticVector, RingBuffer and fixed pools.
Add assertion macros that CI counts.
tasks.done_when: Full branch coverage; zero post-init allocations

tasks.title: Build common units, logging and config
steps: Add strong unit types for time, angle and length.
Load TOML config with toml++ and schema checks.
tasks.done_when: Invalid config fails fast and names the field

tasks.title: Build common frames
steps: Implement WGS84, ECEF and ENU transforms.
Convert MSL to ellipsoid with EGM96.
tasks.done_when: Every golden vector matches within 1 mm

tasks.title: Stand up the SITL rig

tasks.done_when: Nightly CI replays three scripted engagements

tasks.title: Build ics-timingd
tasks.done_when: Holdover flagged within 1 s of GNSS loss on the bench

tasks.title: Capture pcap on TAP ports
steps: Rotate files and hash each on close.

tasks.done_when: SITL replays match truth; 1 h fuzz clean

Map ce and le to σ.
Flag receipt time versus vehicle time.

tasks.title: Import ULog and DataFlash logs

tasks.done_when: Full-rate states extracted from sample logs

tasks.done_when: ≤1 ms error with injected drift on SITL

tasks.title: Wrap the Phantom SDK
tasks.done_when: Ten back-to-back segments offload with verified times

tasks.title: Wrap the FLIR X6980-HS SDK
steps: Configure window, rate and integration time.

tasks.title: Build the strobe latency analyzer

tasks.done_when: SITL feed yields canonical PLI end to end

tasks.title: Deliver ics-camd
steps: Arm and offload on one command.

tasks.title: Build the encoder time-tagger firmware
steps: Select the MCU or FPGA and the encoder tap interface.
Discipline the clock to PPS and PTP.

tasks.title: Build the PWI4 mount client
steps: Implement status, goto and rate commands.
tasks.done_when: Stable 20 to 50 Hz rate loop on a bench mount

tasks.title: Build the sun keep-out interlock
steps: Compute sun position with NREL SPA.
Pre-empt any command entering the 15° cone.
Park the mount on ephemeris or clock fault.
tasks.done_when: Randomized HIL commands never enter the cone

tasks.title: Fit the mount pointing model
tasks.done_when: ≤10 µrad RMS on held-out stars (C17)

tasks.title: Build the encoder module
tasks.done_when: ≤5 µrad error at 0.1 rad/s on the bench

tasks.title: Build the cue extrapolator
steps: Fuse PLI and radar in a constant-acceleration Kalman filter.
Convert to azimuth, elevation and rates.
tasks.done_when: Pointing error <2 mrad on replayed tracks

tasks.title: Build the closed-loop tracker
steps: Stream the tracking camera through Aravis.
Close the loop to mount rates.
tasks.done_when: Target stays in the central half of the narrow field at 500 m (C19)

tasks.title: Build the hand-off scheduler
steps: Queue targets by predicted engagement time.
Flag engagements less than 3 s apart.

tasks.title: Build the trigger controller

tasks.title: Model refraction and turbulence
